name: squishys
description: Dev tooling for the squishys Claude Code mod. The mod's version lives in .claude-plugin/plugin.json.

scripts.typecheck: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts') || (console.error('No engine types yet. Load the mod once with: claude --plugin-dir .'), process.exit(1))" && tsc --noEmit -p .
